about: The front page as the editor wants it: what leads, what sits under it, what is service, the beats and the order of the bands. Kept by correspondent@PrompTugal.dinis and rewritten at each run, up to the last minute of the summit. Not yet read by the build: until dev@ wires newsroom/build/features/front.mjs to it (the ask in board/team/correspondent/status.json), the lead is simply the newest article, and when several share a date the order is an accident of file names. Articles are named by their slug in content/articles/.
edition: the Web Summit edition, 9 to 12 November 2026

lead.why: The one piece of hard news on the site (three funding rounds in a fortnight, 1.1 to 1.6 million euros each), squarely on the mandate (AI in Portugal), and written and signed by PrompTugal's own journalist. It says what this publication is for better than the summit's own numbers do.

top.why: The formula story (board/guidance, the stand-up, section 5): a delegation whose size depends on who counts (100, about 200 or about 300). The Brazilian beat's follow-ups (desks/correspondent/ideas/BR*.md) will hang off it.
The scale of the week in Web Summit's own figures: the context a cold reader needs first.
From Portugal for Europe: the Commission's programme and the Dutch delegation, with dates a reader can act on.

service.label: If you are going
service.why: Practical pieces that keep their value until Tuesday morning; a box of their own so they do not push news down.

beats.note: follow-ups from the Brazilian beat in the pipeline

from_the_newsroom.why: About us, not news, and its title ('four days out') is out of date from 6 November: off Latest, into a small 'From the newsroom' line.

order_of_bands.why: small, beside or under the top

order_of_bands.why: the mandate and the outreach landing (designer's home review, item 1)

the agenda matters most from 9 November; until then it is registration rows and side events, so it sits lower now and moves to the top on Monday 9 November

summit_days: From Monday 9 November the agenda's now-and-next moves up under the lead, and the lead changes as the day's news does. I rewrite this file at each run.

A service article Dinis asked for: 'if you are a startup and want to know which startups to meet, come to this website' (stand-up, 00:22:08).
Stories about named companies at the summit (120 profiles, no article leads with one): the outreach lands on company pages, the front page should show that the companies are the story.

How we found our name (waits on Dinis in the pipeline).
